summary: This declares an interface named TemperatureSensor, a contract that says any real or fake sensor must be able to report a current temperature as a whole number. Code that depends on this interface can work with a hardware sensor in production and a simple stand-in during testing.

lines.text: An interface lists what a type must be able to do without saying how it does it, which lets you swap in a real hardware sensor or a test double later on.
The method has no body, only a signature ending in a semicolon; every class that implements TemperatureSensor must supply its own version that returns an int reading.
